u0360.gist: Portulans Institute's Network Readiness Index 2025 (February 4, 2026) ranked India 45th of 127 economies, with its score up to 54.43.
facts: Released February 4, 2026 by the Portulans Institute; 127 economies, 53 indicators.
Four pillars: Technology, People, Governance and Impact.
Theme: 'AI Governance in a Global Context: Policy and Regulatory Approaches.'
India 45th; score 54.43, up from 53.63 in 2024.
India 2nd among lower-middle-income countries, behind Vietnam.
Top: United States (79.13); last: Burundi (127th).
u0360.trap: It is called NRI 2025 but was released on February 4, 2026.
hindi: Information and communication technology (सूचना एवं संचार प्रौद्योगिकी)

mcq.q: In the Network Readiness Index 2025, released in February 2026, what was India's global rank?
mcq.why: India rose to 45th with a score of 54.43, up from 53.63 in 2024.

u0361.gist: WEF's 21st Global Risks Report (January 14, 2026) warns of an 'Age of Competition'; geo-economic confrontation tops short-term risks.
facts: Published January 14, 2026; 21st edition by the World Economic Forum.
Based on Global Risks Perception Survey (GRPS) and Executive Opinion Survey (EOS).
Top short-term (2-year) risk: geo-economic confrontation; then misinformation and disinformation.
Top long-term (10-year) risk: extreme weather events; then biodiversity loss.
Inequality is the most interconnected global risk.
India's top risk (EOS 2025): cyber insecurity; second: inequality of wealth and income.
u0361.trap: Extreme weather is #1 in the long term but #4 in the short term; geo-economic confrontation is #1 short term.

mcq.q: According to WEF's Global Risks Report 2026, which risk tops India's list for the next two years (EOS 2025)?
mcq.why: For India, EOS 2025 ranks cyber insecurity first, then inequality of wealth and income.

u0362.gist: Dezan Shira & Associates' Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 (January 12, 2026) placed India 6th of 11 Asian economies; China ranked first.
facts: Published January 12, 2026 by Dezan Shira & Associates.
India 6th of 11; its strength: market size and workforce.
Top five: China, Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore, South Korea.
China leads due to a strong industrial base and integrated supply chains.

mcq.q: In the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 by Dezan Shira & Associates, what was India's rank among 11 Asian economies?
mcq.why: AMI 2026 placed India 6th, after China, Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore and South Korea.

u0363.gist: World Inequality Report 2026 (3rd edition, December 2025) finds extreme global inequality; in India the top 10% earn 58% of income.
facts: 3rd edition by World Inequality Lab (December 2025); editors include Thomas Piketty and Lucas Chancel.
Globally: top 10% hold nearly 75% of wealth; bottom 50% own only 2%.
India: top 10% earn 58% of national income; bottom 50% get only 15%.
India: richest 10% own about 65% of wealth; top 1% about 40%.
India's female labour income share: 15.7% in both 2014 and 2024.
Climate: top 10% cause 77% of capital-linked emissions; poorest 50% only 3%.
u0363.hook: India's income split '58–15': the top tenth takes 58%, the bottom half gets 15%.

mcq.q: According to the World Inequality Report 2026, what share of India's national income goes to the top 10%?
mcq.why: The top 10% earn 58% of India's national income; the bottom 50% get 15%.

u0364.gist: The Center for Global Development's Commitment to Development Index 2025 (November 20, 2025) ranked India 36th overall; Sweden topped.
facts: Released November 20, 2025 by the Center for Global Development.
Measures how major economies' policies, beyond foreign aid, help or hurt poorer countries.
Top: Sweden (1st), Germany (2nd), Norway (3rd), then Finland and the UK.
Major economies lag: US 28th, China 34th.
India: 36th overall and 30th on the income-adjusted rank (progressive relative to its resource base).
India: 8th in Environment among 38 CDI economies; 38th in Trade and in Development Finance.
u0364.check: The line 'India ranks 36th overall and 30th on the income-adjusted rank, not 29th' reads like an editorial correction left in the print.

mcq.q: In the Commitment to Development Index (CDI) 2025, released in November 2025, what was India's overall rank?
mcq.why: India ranked 36th overall and 30th on the income-adjusted rank.

u0364.trap: India's best component is Environment (8th); its worst are Trade and Development Finance (38th).

u0365.gist: On October 19, 2026, the EU signed an Association Agreement with Andorra and San Marino, bringing them into the EU Single Market without membership.
facts: Signed October 19, 2026 in Brussels by the European Commission on behalf of the EU.
Mixed Agreement: free movement of goods, services, capital and persons, with conditions.
Talks began in 2015; Monaco's talks suspended September 2023; concluded December 2023.
Council of the EU authorised signing and provisional application on 16 July 2026.
Full implementation needs approvals, including European Parliament consent; Article 112(3) allows provisional application.
Andorra (2011), San Marino (2012) use the euro by monetary agreement; may issue coins, not banknotes.
u0365.trap: Monaco was in the talks, but they were suspended in September 2023; only Andorra and San Marino signed.

mcq.q: On October 19, 2026, the European Union signed an Association Agreement with which two European microstates?
mcq.why: The EU signed with Andorra and San Marino; talks with Monaco were suspended in September 2023.

u0365.hook: Nickname 'EEA Plus' (Maroš Šefčovič, December 2023); the official legal name stays Association Agreement.

u0366.gist: UN DESA's World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (November 2025) named Jakarta the world's most populous city, ahead of Dhaka and Tokyo.
facts: Released November 2025 by the UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA).
Jakarta, Indonesia: first, about 42 million people.
Dhaka, Bangladesh: second, 37 million; Tokyo slipped to third, 33 million.
Nine of the world's ten most populous cities are in Asia, including New Delhi and Kolkata.
u0366.hook: Top three J-D-T, falling sizes: Jakarta 42, Dhaka 37, Tokyo 33 (million).
u0366.trap: Tokyo is now third, not first; Jakarta leads.

mcq.q: According to the UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025, which city is the world's most populous?
mcq.why: Jakarta ranks first with about 42 million, then Dhaka (37 million) and Tokyo (33 million).

u0367.gist: On October 14, 2026, India approved joining SIOFA, a body for sustainable high-seas fishing in the southern Indian Ocean.
facts: SIOFA = Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement; India approved accession on October 14, 2026.
India a Cooperating Non-Contracting Party since 2022; full membership pending as of October 21, 2026.
Accession takes effect 30 days after depositing the instrument with FAO's Director-General.
Signed in Rome on July 7, 2006; in force June 21, 2012; HQ: Le Port, Réunion (France).
Covers squid, toothfish and alfonsino, not tuna; tuna is regulated by IOTC.
Fights Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated (IUU) fishing.
u0367.trap: SIOFA excludes tuna; tuna comes under the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC).

mcq.q: Where is the headquarters of the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA), which India approved joining in October 2026?
mcq.why: SIOFA, a Regional Fisheries Management Organisation, is headquartered in Le Port, Réunion (France).

u0368.gist: Amit Shah chaired the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi (October 13, 2026), which adopted the Delhi Declaration on security.
facts: Held in New Delhi, October 13, 2026; all seven members adopted the Delhi Declaration.
Idea proposed at 4th Summit (Kathmandu, 2018); welcomed at 6th Summit (Bangkok, 2025).
Approved: draft Convention Against Human Trafficking, Drug Control Action Plan, anti-money-laundering MoU, and more.
BIMSTEC Centre of Excellence for disaster management proposed at Jamnagar, Gujarat.
BIMSTEC founded 6 June 1997 (Bangkok Declaration), first called BIST-EC; Secretariat in Dhaka.
Secretary-General Indra Mani Pandey (India) since 4 January 2024; 2026 Chair: Bangladesh.
u0368.hook: BIST-EC = the four founders: Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka, Thailand.
u0368.trap: Myanmar joined in 1997, Nepal and Bhutan in 2004 — they were not founding members.

mcq.q: Who chaired the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting held in New Delhi on October 13, 2026?
mcq.why: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the meeting, which adopted the Delhi Declaration.

mcq.q: Where is a BIMSTEC Centre of Excellence for disaster management proposed, as per the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting (2026)?
mcq.why: A BIMSTEC Centre of Excellence is proposed at Jamnagar, Gujarat.

u0369.gist: FAO's 28th Committee on Forestry session (Rome, 28 September–2 October 2026) met under 'Forests for Food, Resilience and Prosperity'; India showcased restoration work.
facts: COFO (set up 1971): FAO's top forestry body; 128 members; 10th World Forest Week held alongside.
SOFO 2026: 1.56 billion hectares degraded land; up to US$30 return per US$1 invested.
ISFR 2023: India's forest and tree cover 25.17%; forest cover alone 21.76%.
India ranks 9th in forest area, 3rd in net annual forest gain (FAO FRA 2025).
Bonn Challenge: restore 26 million hectares by 2030; MISHTI: 54,000 hectares mangroves by 2028.
Ramsar sites rose to 103 with Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh) and Sauj Jheel (Uttar Pradesh), 15 October 2026.
u0369.trap: 21.76 appears twice: forest cover 21.76% and 21.76 million hectares restored during 2011–2020.

mcq.q: Which Uttar Pradesh wetland was added as a Ramsar site on 15 October 2026, taking India's total to 103?
mcq.why: Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh) and Sauj Jheel (Uttar Pradesh) were added on 15 October 2026.

mcq.q: As per ISFR 2023, cited by India at FAO's COFO 28 in 2026, India's combined forest and tree cover is:
mcq.why: Combined cover is 8,27,357 sq km (25.17%): forest 21.76% plus tree cover 3.41%.

u0370.gist: Finland's President Stubb and Norway's PM Støre launched 'A Call for Control of Frontier AI Models' at the 81st UNGA on September 21, 2026.
facts: Launched September 21, 2026 in New York, during the 81st UNGA High-Level Week.
Aim: keep advanced AI under human oversight and control.
Frontier AI = highly advanced models matching or beyond leading existing systems.
Initially 22 leaders from 20 countries plus European Commission; 31 leaders from 29 countries by 21 October 2026.
France joined on 23 September 2026; Singapore was the only Southeast Asian participant.
India, US, China, UK, Japan and South Korea were not listed supporters (as of 21 October).

o: Ursula von der Leyen and Emmanuel Macron
Alexander Stubb and Jonas Gahr Støre
mcq.why: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Støre launched it on September 21, 2026.

u0371.gist: TIME100 Next 2026 (September 30, 2026) named cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 15, its youngest member, and Skyroot's Pawan Kumar Chandana.
facts: TIME100 Next launched 2019; five categories: Phenoms, Artists, Leaders, Innovators, Advocates.
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (Samastipur, Bihar), Phenoms category, youngest on the list at 15.

u0372.gist: Partners for Multilateralism (P4M) was launched on September 21, 2026 at the 81st UNGA, co-chaired by S. Jaishankar and António Costa.
facts: Launched September 21, 2026 in New York, during the 81st UNGA.
Co-chairs: EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar and European Council President António Costa.
Founding partners: India, Australia, Barbados, Brazil, Canada, Kenya and the EU.
Open, voluntary platform for UN-centred multilateralism and institutional reform.

u0373.gist: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi (12–13 September 2026), adopting the New Delhi BRICS Leaders' Declaration.
facts: Held 12–13 September 2026, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; declaration adopted on 12 September.

mcq.q: India's BRICS Presidency that began on 1 January 2026 is its which presidency of the grouping?

u0374.gist: Under India's 2026 BRICS chairship, sectoral meetings were held across India, including Lucknow, Indore, Guwahati, Hyderabad and Bhubaneswar.

u0375.gist: The 27th World Knowledge Forum (September 8–10, 2026, Seoul) discussed AI as the 'fire of the 21st century' under a Promethean theme.
facts: Held September 8–10, 2026 at Jangchung Arena and The Shilla Seoul, South Korea.

u0377.gist: At the 48th World Heritage Committee (Busan, July 19–29, 2026), 25 sites were added; Italy leads with 62 sites, India is sixth with 45.

u0378.gist: On July 1, 2026, the UN's Independent International Scientific Panel on AI released its first report, warning AI is outpacing understanding and safeguards.

40 independent experts from all five UN regional groups; three-year terms.

Assesses only non-military AI; has no regulatory or enforcement powers.
IndiaAI Mission (March 2024): ₹10,371.92 crore outlay; over 38,000 GPUs onboarded.

mcq.q: Who are the Co-Chairs of the UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, which released its first report on July 1, 2026?

u0379.gist: The Second Pax Silica Summit (Washington, D.C., 25–26 June 2026) focused on secure AI supply chains; thirty-five countries including India signed an AI statement.

u0382.gist: India hosted the 11th Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 26, 2026, launching maritime surveillance, energy and critical-minerals initiatives.

facts: 48th Summit: May 6–8, 2026, LapuLapu City, Cebu; chaired by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

mcq.why: King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri on September 29, 2026.

u0388.gist: A military mutiny in Niamey, Niger (August 28–29, 2026) against President Abdourahamane Tiani's government was suppressed.
facts: Mutiny began about 12:20 a.m. on 29 August 2026 at Air Base 101, Niamey.
Niger's Defence Ministry and AES said it was suppressed; Russia reported help from its Africa Corps.
Niger: independent from France 3 August 1960; successful coups in 1974, 1996, 1999, 2010, 2023.
2023 coup (26 July) removed Mohamed Bazoum; 2025 Charter gave Tiani a 60-month transition.
AES = Niger, Mali, Burkina Faso; they left ECOWAS on 29 January 2025.
AU Constitutive Act Article 30 bars governments that take power unconstitutionally.
u0388.trap: AES began as the Alliance of Sahel States (Liptako-Gourma Charter, 2023) and became a confederation in 2024.

mcq.q: Which three countries form the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), which withdrew from ECOWAS on 29 January 2025?
mcq.why: Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso formed AES through the Liptako-Gourma Charter (16 September 2023).

u0389.gist: Balendra Shah (Balen) became Nepal's youngest democratically elected PM on March 27, 2026, after Gen Z protests toppled the Oli government.
facts: Became PM on March 27, 2026; party: Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP).
Rapper, engineer and former Mayor of Kathmandu.
Gen Z movement erupted September 2025 after a ban on 26 social media platforms.
Anger over corruption and nepotism ('Nepo Kids'); PM K.P. Sharma Oli resigned.
Sushila Karki, a former Chief Justice, became interim PM — Nepal's first woman PM.
Balen's rise reflects young voters, anti-corruption politics and anti-establishment mood.

mcq.q: Which party's 2026 election win made Balendra Shah Nepal's youngest democratically elected Prime Minister?
mcq.why: The Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) secured a strong mandate in the 2026 election.

mcq.q: Who became Nepal's first woman Prime Minister (interim) after the Gen Z movement of September 2025?
mcq.why: Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki was sworn in as interim PM, the first woman in the post.

u0389.trap: Balen = youngest democratically elected PM (2026); Sushila Karki = first woman PM (interim, after the 2025 protests).

u0390.gist: A rock–ice avalanche set off a catastrophic flash flood in Nepal's Rasuwa district on August 26, 2026; India sent rescue and forensic help.
facts: August 26, 2026: flash flood in Rasuwa, near the Nepal–China border, on Lhende Khola–Bhote Koshi–Trishuli rivers.
ICIMOD: slope failure on Langtang Lirung caused a rock–ice avalanche — not a conventional GLOF.
Trishuli River rose about nine metres within 30 minutes at Galchhi.
India: NDRF teams in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, tunnel-rescue staff, 19-member forensic team.
GLOF = flood when a glacial lake's ice or moraine dam fails.
The debris-laden flood damaged settlements, roads, bridges, hydropower projects and communication networks.
u0390.trap: Rasuwa flood was mainly an avalanche-induced cascading hazard, not a conventional GLOF.

mcq.q: According to ICIMOD, what mainly triggered the flash flood in Nepal's Rasuwa district on August 26, 2026?
o: A rock–ice avalanche from Langtang Lirung
mcq.why: A slope failure on Langtang Lirung triggered a rock–ice avalanche, not a conventional GLOF.

u0391.gist: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake hit western Colombia on August 10, 2026 — the country's largest of the 21st century — leading to an emergency.
facts: August 10, 2026; epicentre near San José del Palmar, Chocó Department; depth about 103 km.
Colombian Geological Service: largest-magnitude earthquake of the 21st century in Colombia.
Cause: the oceanic Nazca Plate subducts beneath the South American Plate.
Colombia lies on the Circum-Pacific Belt, about 40,000 km around the Pacific.
This subduction also built the Andes Mountains and feeds volcanism.

mcq.q: The 7.4-magnitude Colombia earthquake of August 10, 2026 is linked to which oceanic plate subducting beneath the South American Plate?
mcq.why: Along Colombia's Pacific margin, the oceanic Nazca Plate subducts beneath the South American Plate.

u0392.gist: On 26 June 2026, India launched Operation Amistad to help Venezuela after two earthquakes of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 on 24 June.
facts: Launched 26 June 2026; earthquakes of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 struck Venezuela on 24 June.
IAF sent two C-17 Globemaster III aircraft with medical staff and relief.
Two BHISHM Cubes (portable modular hospitals) deployed under the Aarogya Maitri Initiative.
BHISHM = Bharat Health Initiative for Sahyog, Hita and Maitri.
Past missions: Maitri (Nepal, 2015), Rahat (Yemen, 2015), Sankat Mochan (South Sudan, 2016), Kaveri (Sudan, 2023).
Samudra Setu (2020, COVID-19 repatriation), Devi Shakti (Afghanistan, 2021), Ganga (Ukraine, 2022).

mcq.q: India launched Operation Amistad in June 2026 to give earthquake relief to which country?
mcq.why: Operation Amistad (26 June 2026) supported Venezuela after earthquakes of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5.

u0392.hook: Amistad = 'Friendship' in Spanish — India's friendship mission to Venezuela.
u0392.trap: Two Sudans: Sankat Mochan went to South Sudan (2016); Kaveri went to Sudan (2023).

u0393.gist: News shorts: California banned child marriage, Scotland legalised water cremation, Spain banned social media for under-16s, and India hosted CSPOC 2026.
facts: California AB 1267 (signed September 30, 2026): marriage age 18, no exceptions; 18th US state.
Scotland: first UK nation to legalise water cremation (alkaline hydrolysis); about 7 times less CO2.
Maduro captured by US forces on January 3, 2026 (Operation Absolute Resolve); Delcy Rodríguez acting president.
Spain: first European country to ban social media for under-16s; second globally after Australia.
WTO MC-14 (March 2026), Yaoundé, Cameroon: no broad consensus; Bulgaria became 21st euro-area member (1 January 2026).
India hosted 28th CSPOC, New Delhi (14–16 January 2026); CEC Gyanesh Kumar chairs International IDEA Council 2026.
Durand Line (Pakistan–Afghanistan): about 2,640 km, drawn 1893; Finke River (Australia): world's oldest river system.
u0393.hook: Double 18: marriage age 18, and California is the 18th state. China's CR450 hit 453 km/h — just above its name number.

mcq.q: Under AB 1267, signed on September 30, 2026, California became which US state to completely ban child marriage?
mcq.why: Effective 1 January 2027, California became the 18th U.S. state to fully ban child marriage.

mcq.q: Which country hosted the 28th Conference of Speakers and Presiding Officers of the Commonwealth (CSPOC) in January 2026?
mcq.why: India hosted the 28th CSPOC in New Delhi from 14–16 January 2026.

u0393.trap: Spain is first in Europe but second in the world to ban social media for under-16s (Australia was first, December 2025).

u0394.gist: India ran Operation Sagar Bandhu for Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah (November 2025); Ethiopia's Hayli Gubbi volcano erupted on 23 November 2025.
facts: Cyclone Ditwah hit Sri Lanka in the last week of November 2025.
India's HADR mission for Sri Lanka: Operation Sagar Bandhu, meaning 'Ocean Friend'.
Deployed INS Vikrant, INS Udaygiri, INS Sukanya and an IAF C-130J aircraft.
Hayli Gubbi: volcano in Ethiopia's Afar region, near the Erta Ale volcanic range.
Erupted 23 November 2025 — its first documented explosive eruption in about 12,000 years.
u0394.hook: Sagar Bandhu = Ocean Friend: India's navy ships as friends across the sea.

mcq.q: Which operation did India launch in November 2025 to give relief to Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah?
mcq.why: India launched Operation Sagar Bandhu (Ocean Friend) as an HADR mission for Sri Lanka.

mcq.q: The Hayli Gubbi volcano, which erupted on 23 November 2025 for the first time in about 12,000 years, is in which country?
mcq.why: Hayli Gubbi is in Ethiopia's Afar region, near the Erta Ale volcanic range.

u0395.gist: Summary table of 2025 and 2026 international indices with India's ranks, e.g. Global Hunger 100th, Press Freedom 157th, Rule of Law 88th.
facts: Human Development Report 2025 (UNDP): India 130 of 193; Iceland top.
Global Innovation Index 2025 (WIPO): India 38th; Corruption Perceptions Index 2025: India 91st.
Global Peace Index 2026: India 127th; Global Terrorism Index 2026: India 13th (Pakistan 1st).
Index of Economic Freedom 2026 (Heritage Foundation): India 132nd; Global Fire Power 2026: India 4th.
Sustainable Development Report 2026: India 94th of 169; Democracy Index 2025 (EIU): India 47th.
Nature Conservation Index 2025: India 172nd of 180; International IP Index 2026: 43rd of 55.
u0395.trap: Don't mix the Global Peace Index (India 127th) with the Global Terrorism Index (India 13th).
u0395.check: Two 'Top Rankings' cells are still scrambled in print: Nature Conservation Index 2025 (Estonia/Luxembourg) and IP Index 2026 (United States/France).

mcq.q: In UNDP's Human Development Report 2025, what was India's rank among 193 countries?
mcq.why: UNDP's HDR 2025 placed India 130 out of 193; Iceland ranked first.

mcq.q: As per the 2026 rankings summary, which country ranked 1st in the Global Terrorism Index 2026?
mcq.why: GTI 2026: 1. Pakistan, 2. Burkina Faso, 3. Niger; India was 13th.

u1302.gist: Joint US–Israeli strikes on February 28, 2026 widened the Iran–Israel war and killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei; his son Mojtaba succeeded him.
facts: February 28, 2026 strikes: US called it Operation Epic Fury; Israel, Operation Roaring Lion; Iran replied 'True Promise'.
Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei (since 1989) killed; son Mojtaba, selected by Assembly of Experts, announced March 9, 2026.
June 2025: Israel's 12-day Operation Rising Lion; Iran hit back with Operation True Promise 3.
US 'Operation Midnight Hammer': B-2 bombers struck Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan; India launched Operation Sindhu.
Strait of Hormuz (Iran–Oman) links Persian Gulf to Arabian Sea; Kharg Island handles ~90% of Iran's crude exports.
Modi: first leader honoured by both Israel (Knesset Medal, February 25, 2026) and Palestine (Grand Collar, 2018).
u1302.hook: Lions are Israel's: Rising Lion (June 2025), Roaring Lion (February 2026). US names: Midnight Hammer, Epic Fury. Iran: True Promise.
u1302.trap: Rising Lion (Israel, June 2025) vs Roaring Lion (Israel, February 2026): one word apart.

mcq.q: What name did the United States give to the joint US–Israeli strikes on Iran on February 28, 2026?
mcq.why: The US called it Operation Epic Fury; Israel called it Operation Roaring Lion.

mcq.q: PM Modi received Israel's Speaker of the Knesset Medal on February 25, 2026. Which honour had Palestine conferred on him in 2018?
o: Grand Collar of the State of Palestine
mcq.why: In 2018 Modi received the Grand Collar of the State of Palestine from Mahmoud Abbas.
